a-regressors-tale-of-cultivation:
On the way to a company workshop, we fell into a world of immortal cultivators while still in the car.
Those with spiritual roots and unique abilities were all called to join cultivation sects, living prosperously.
But I, having neither spiritual roots nor special abilities, lived as an ordinary mortal for 50 years, complying with fate until my death.
That’s what I thought.
Until I regressed.
apocalypse-counterattack-of-a-cannon-fod:
In his previous life, Tang Shi was a cannon fodder. For a jerk, he even turned down a blind date his father arranged for him, but finally died in the hands of his lover and half-blooded elder brother.
Before he died, his elder brother told him that the one that always went against him, teased him and used him as a bait was the one who truly loved him, also that blind date his father had arranged for him—Yan Xu.
Feeling regretful?
What would have happened if he hadn’t made that kind of choice from the very beginning?
apocalypse-descends-i-win-effortlessly-b:
A strange energy invades, the apocalypse descends, and Perry Yates is pulled into a survival game with only a 10% chance of survival.
Amidst the extremely high mortality rate, there are rewards that drive people to madness, and for Perry, this is even more so.
At the start, she awakens the SSS Talent, Ascension, capable of ascending everything.
Common leaves found everywhere in the game? One touch, and they become miracle cures for any ailment.
Ordinary wild fruits? One touch, and they become spiritual fruits that enhance the body beyond human limits.
A worthless trash card that no one wants? One touch, and it becomes a level card that grants people special abilities.
With this talent in hand, Perry quickly rises to become the game's most famous and most mysterious item supplier—a name that everyone knows, but no one can trace.
ascension-of-the-unholy-immortal:
In a world where the boundaries of time blur and eternity is but a fleeting concept, the relentless pursuit of immortality has captivated countless souls.
At the center of this eternal struggle is Liang, whose life approaches its final chapter. After six hundred years, he has reached the limits of his potential.
Haunted by the limits of his mortality, Liang devises a daring plan to shatter the confines of his destiny and achieve true immortality.
But is he genuinely shaping a new destiny, defying the predetermined course of his life? Or is he merely walking a path that fate has already laid out for him?
“Which is more ambitious: the heart of a mortal or the will of heaven?”
You would probably have to read to find out (^_^)
becoming-the-wind:
Reyhan Alther died at the age of 20 and was reincarnated… as the wind. Formless and directionless, he drifted through a new world filled with wonder and cruelty. But from that breeze, everything began. With a mysterious power called the Divine Spirit System, Reyhan slowly rose—guiding spirits, gathering followers, and changing the course of the world. From a lonely gust, he became a figure known as Father… even to the gods.
A battle of fate awaits. But before that, there's still time for the wind to whisper… and maybe crack a small joke or two.
blessed-by-night:
In the year 2033 it began.
Gods, monsters, devils, angels every higher creature from every mythology began to bless those they found worthy and share their powers.
Eventually with the emergence of the gates, we realized they were preparing us.
The so called chosen heroes who enter gates are known as the Blessed and in it’s become the most sought after career in the world.
They are the most famous and well known people in the entire world and some are even the leaders of their own nations.
They are immensely powerful, beautiful, and charming beings.
After five whole years, we still have no idea what the higher’s criteria are for blessing a human.
Despite the seemingly loose criteria, only 1 percent of the population actually end up as blessed and gain the privilege of entering gates and defending our world.
With all of the excitement around the Blessed, we seem to have forgotten the most important question.
Why are they doing this for us and what will they require in return?
btth-i-am-thunder-emperor:
This is a world of Dou Qi, where there is no dazzling magic, only the pure and ultimate cultivation of Dou Qi! A young man from Earth, now living his third life, is reborn into the Dou Qi Continent, carrying the twelve Thunder Soul from another world, ready to reclaim the name of the Thunder Emperor!

building-the-ultimate-fantasy:
A young man sat on a chair and looked out at the ocean. With one wisp of Spirit Qi, he could point anywhere on this vast and expansive world, pointing at any place that didn’t look right.
Someone once became the last one to wield a knife that could decapitate huge dragons and bathed in dragons’ blood.
Someone once loved treating others to chicken soup, so he kept nine phoenixes in his backyard. Someone once sat lazily on the top of mountains as his words flooded river banks, and his qi could hold a million soldiers back.
Someone once moved mountains and shifted hills with just one brush, his paintings so captivating it could enchant immortals and deities.
That year, the warmth of spring made the flowers bloom.
They were merely an ordinary butcher, a bookworm, a chicken farmer and a poor artist.
This is the story of how a Low Level Martial World Continent was transformed into the Ultimate Fantasy Universe.
by-seeing-beasts-training-paths-my-beast:
A world where mana density was extremely abundant. Because of that, the world connected to a special place through an ancient gate—the World of Beasts. Through this connection with beasts, mankind became superhuman, wielding power capable of tearing apart sky and ground.
However, too much of anything is never a good thing. Countless dungeons appeared across the rifts… and demons.
Rocky Stephens, the first son of a Great Clan, the reincarnator, carrying memories from another world.… yet also a useless piece of trash. No one even remembered his name. His parents died. Betrayed by the branch clan, his beast was killed. He lived in a phase he had never dreamed of—a nightmare.
When a second chance came, he returned to the World of Beasts… and awakened a system that could see through all Beasts’ training paths!
With the system, his beast could level up like the wind… it could learn and upgrade its skills on its own, and even more.
daily-life-with-my-busty-and-cute-girlfr:
Leo, an introverted gamer struggling with post-university job hunting and financial stability, finds his world illuminated by Sarah his childhood friend who was now his girlfriend, a vibrant, impulsive aspiring model and actress who is mindlessly in love with him...
Unbeknownst to Leo, Sarah carries a devastating secret that changes everything...
(NO NTR)
(No YURI)
Just Peak Content...
dawn-of-a-new-rome:
Torn from the 21st century, an ordinary man is suddenly Emperor Constantine the Great, with Constantinople's grand dedication mere days away. Raw and reeling, he has to quickly master the savage game of Roman imperial politics just to keep breathing. His only edge? Knowledge from a future they can't fathom, knowledge he’ll need to sidestep deadly plots and begin shaping a “New Rome” that history was never meant to see.
While he wrestled with reforms that smashed against stubborn traditions, the Emperor's crown a constant, heavy burden, the world itself began to shift in ways no scholar could explain. A quiet magic was at work. He'd get the reports: coastlines inexplicably pushing further to sea, an unsettling trend of people living past their time, familiar charts turning into hopeful guesses as new lands emerged from nowhere. Now, this accidental emperor wasn't just fighting human ambition; he was contending with a reality actively remaking itself. He would have to forge a new destiny for this strange, transforming empire, and with every hard choice, discover the ruthless leader he was becoming.…
dawning-skye:
When Skye Moonstone’s wedding is interrupted by her former, supposedly deceased betrothed: her life becomes a series of complications, mystery, and excitement.
Knowing only of the boy that he used to be, Skye finds herself drawn to the man that Prince Tidas has become. Intelligent, strong, and charismatic; he had decided long ago to do whatever it takes to protect the love of his life. No matter the risk to his body or soul..
Throughout her many trials, Skye will learn that her home, family, and even personal history are all stories meant to keep her safe. That her true purpose is not just to save her love, but her entire world. The fates of both Humans and Fae alike will rest upon her shoulders..
Intrigue, legends, and her place in it all will lead Skye down a path that she knows she may not come back from. But to save the lives of her loved ones, she’ll risk her very existence..
Whatever it takes to save them.
Magic, Fae, War, Fate; they all reside within this epic love tale of fantasy. All can be found within the Dawning Skye.. One simply needs to look.

After being blackballed to the point of quitting the industry and jumping into the sea, the female lead not only lived in her house, spent her money, but also used her child to make a counterattack comeback!

A certain business tycoon held back his laughter, “That's your biological mom.…
dungeon-of-lust-managing-otherworldly-be:
{WARNING: MATURE CONTENT 18+}
A man wakes up in an endless white void with a strange voice whispering in his ear about how he’s become the new owner of the Dungeon of Lust. He doesn’t take it too seriously at first, but when he learns his life may be in jeopardy, all his reserves fall to the wayside.
It’s not long after he realizes the true peril of his situation that the voice in his head grants him the ability to summon defenders to help him; however, to claim sovereignty over his legion and rule these summoned defenders, he has to fulfill a condition with them: satisfaction.
He grows confused at this condition until an otherworldly beauty appears in front of him, flaunting her alluring figure. Then, Vale, the man, learns just what it means to be the owner of the Dungeon of Lust.
He struggles to hold his morals, but when the vice of lust is suppressed… it only gets stronger.
fairy-tail-i-stole-the-ryujin-jakka-in-m:
Finn was just an ordinary boy until an unexpected twist of fate granted him a second chance at life in the magical world of Fairy Tail. Initially disheartened by his ordinary status, he soon discovers a hidden potential within. While asleep, a mysterious system guides him into the realm of Bleach, where he cunningly steals the legendary Zanpakuto: Ryujin Jakka.
Upon waking, he finds the powerful sword by his side, igniting a new determination within him. With the fiery spirit of Ryujin Jakka at his command, Finn embarks on a journey of self-discovery and training, determined to carve out his place in this enchanting world.
His path soon crosses with Gildarts, a seasoned magician of the Fairy Tail guild, who recognizes Finn's potential and invites him into the fold. As Finn navigates friendships, rivalries, and the challenges of guild life, he learns that being ordinary is just the beginning of his extraordinary adventure. With the power of fire at his fingertips and the bonds of friendship to guide him, he sets out to prove that even an ordinary boy can become a legend.
from-treasure-hunting-streamer-to-crime-:
Qiao An, a Beast Taming Clan member who accidentally transmigrated to Blue Planet, becomes a professional Treasure Hunter. She live-streams diligently every day; while others appraise treasures, she digs pits, running through the wilderness in search of treasure. She didn't become a popular internet celebrity, but instead dug up fragments of people...
Inside the police station, Qiao An states the whole incident, tremblingly pleading her innocence and blamelessness.
Resuming her live stream, she once again digs up a crime weapon, returning to the familiar place and facing the familiar handsome young man.
“Please, Heavens, distinguish the loyal from the treacherous!”
“I was just born with the fate of a police dog, do you believe me?”
Unexpectedly, Qiao An's string of nonsense was actually accepted, and she became an external contractor for the police department, specializing in providing case clues.
Targeted by bad guys? No fear! The treasure-hunting streamer moonlights in solving crimes, with her fluffy companions escorting her!
glamorous-doctor: Zhang Yang, the office drone, spent his days slacking off with the campus beauty and his nights watching his sister-in-law practice leg lifts. His girlfriend Xiao Man watched him every day, falling deep in thought... Until one day, while straddling Zhang Yang, she unleashed a soul-searching interrogation, “Why did the dean bow to you? Why did the richest man gift you a villa? Why did the tattoo-covered big brother kneel before you, begging you to take his wife?”
global-collapse:
Gu Mian is the most unlucky person in the whole world. He is involved in many accidents everyday, each of which aims to kill him.
One day, the Global Evolution Game starts, allowing everyone to enhance themselves by clearing instances. Even in this game launched by the planet Earth itself, Gu finds himself still being targeted, with less game functions available than other players. However, he is able to do things that others cannot, such as punching NPCs in instances...

having-wives-and-raising-children-levels:
“Hey, have you heard?” A noble asked his fellow colleagues.
“About what?”
“I heard that lazy son of the Rin Household walked up to the Chan Household last night to offer the Head of the Chan Household his Rin family potion-making secret recipe in exchange for the hand in marriage of the Chan Household's beautiful daughter.”
“What? You mean he asked to marry the talented, beautiful fairy goddess of this era?”
“Yep, you heard correctly.”
“Oh my goodness. Is he smoking mushrooms for him to be so desperate to sell his own family secret? And what makes him believe he could ever have a chance with that beautiful goddess?”
These were the words whispered by the nobles about a young man, but the young man's body was also the same person Austin's soul had transmigrated into.
However, upon awakening in this new Game-Like World, Austin's eyes widened in surprise when he read the words displayed on a screen in front of him.…
i-am-the-villainess-who-will-tame-every-:
After Amihan, politician by day and otaku by night, died from a political assassination, she got transmigrated as the saintess in another world. But she always felt like a fraud. Why? If she was the chosen one, why did she feel so rotten inside?
Also, wasn't she atheist?
However, her years of forced piety and suppressed desires ended in spectacular failure - her decapitation.
Three days later, she woke to the sight of a worshiper bowing low. “Welcome back, O Sun Who Burns The World,” they said.
'Wait. What? I'm not the Saintess? I was this all along?'
Furious at the wasted years of celibacy, moral dilemmas, and suffocating oaths, Serafine made a vow: no more pretending. No more rules. The world? Hers to ruin. The people? Playthings.
But wait. It was harder than she thought because...
How in the name of the Goddess Aurelia was she supposed to have her debut when she was surrounded by a bunch of suspicious and crazy beautiful women who wants to hunt her down?!
This was no different from her previous world!
i-help-the-richest-man-spend-money-to-pr:
Ye Zhi inherited not only a run-down house, but also an engagement. Her fiancé met his true love and suddenly asked to break off the engagement while stating that he disliked his fiancée in all ways around.
In order to express their guilt, his family decided to make up for it with Ye Zhi. But she didn’t want a dime from them so she left.
The next second, Ye Zhi was suddenly picked up by a Rolls Royce.
————-
Gu Ren, the son of the richest man alive, had a tough life and was told that he couldn’t live past 30 years old. Only Ye Zhi, a young lady born on the cloudy day of the lunar year, could make him live.
Ye Zhi and Gu Ren got married. Gu Ren gave her a bank card. All she has to do is—
Spend money for him! Squander his fortune!
Ye Zhi bought a Lamborghini for Gu Ren, but he had an accident as soon as he drove the car.
As soon as she bought some Hermes platinum bags for herself, Gu Ren signed a more than one billion worth contract.
It turned out that the money could only be spent on herself. The more she spent, the more prosperous and healthy he would become.
Since then, her life had changed completely. Her villa was the biggest in the City.…
infinite-class-awakening-i-level-up-1000:
In a world overrun by monsters, everyone awakens a class at the age of eighteen. Most people are permanently restricted to a single profession and a level of potential they can never surpass.
Adrian is different.
During his Awakening Ceremony, he unlocks a class that has never been recorded before.
[Unique Class awakened: Infinite Sovereign.]
[Class limit removed.]
That same night, Adrian opens his eyes ten thousand years in the future. Humanity has vanished, and the ruins of its cities are occupied by the corpses of warriors who reached levels of power unimaginable in his era.
After defeating the first one, Adrian discovers the true ability of his class.
[Future warrior defeated.]
[Class acquired: Starbreaker.]
[Combat memories absorbed.]
[Unit registered.]
Every enemy Adrian defeats in the future can grant him their class, techniques, and centuries of combat experience. The strongest among them can even become units under his command.
While the geniuses of the present compete over A-Rank skills, Adrian learns martial arts perfected over the next ten thousand years.…
limitless-evolution-summoning-villains-w:
“Alex Blade – the King in Gray had perished. The End.”
James, a die-hard fan of Villain's Ascension, felt his world fall apart at the utterly horrible ending of his favorite webnovel.
As he was going through this horrible heartbreak, a mysterious caller asked him:
“Do you want to change the ending?”
Furious at the fool of an author, James agreed.
The next moment, he found himself at the Solace Academy and on the very day Alex's journey had started.
He had become Alex Blade. The protagonist of Villain's Ascension. The only Player with an SSS-Rank talent.
With his broken talent and the original plot's knowledge, James had everything he needed to create his perfect ending.
However, things were a little different...
[Ding!]
[You have awakened a talent — Hall of Great Evils (SSS)!]
[You have been chosen as the host of the Evolution System!]
With the skills provided by the Evolution System, Alex could use his SSS-Rank talent to its fullest while also evolving without any limit.
magic-smithing:
I put all the warning tags to give myself creative freedom, but the story isn't filled with excessive gore or swearing.
This is my first time writing other than for school projects. The gender-bender tag is only for the beginning because I wanted to try writing from a female's perspective and needed an excuse for why my MC reads a little tomboyish. The gender-bender fades into the background over the first few chapters; please don't let the tag keep you from trying out my story.
Synopsis:
Second chances are rarely earned and even rarer given. Follow a new life in a new world where anything is possible. Our MC wakes up, stuck as a baby, needing to decide how she will live her new life. Let's see what future she can forge when hard work rewards her with status points and skill levels.
Author's Note: I'm currently slowly going back and rewriting my earlier chapters, so if you're starting to read this for the first time, try not to be alarmed if the quality suddenly goes down after reading a few chapters. I started writing this story almost three years ago, and I think I've improved as a writer since then. I appreciate your understanding; enjoy.
marrying-the-richest-man-while-pregnant:

However, the eldest daughter of the Fang family, Fang Liu, had a low IQ since she was young and only started to speak when she was eight years old. Her parents regarded her as a burden while the outside world treated her as a laughing stock.
However, no one knew that Fang Liu was an ultimate prodigy whose intelligence merely developed late. Afterward, Fang Liu got pregnant for no reason. Four months into her pregnancy, her parents forced her to marry the richest man in South City, the Mo family. Rumors had it that her husband was an old man who had been paralyzed in bed since the age of seven. Unexpectedly, when Fang Liu married into the Mo family, she found out that not only was her husband not an old man, he was also extremely handsome.…

Yun Wanqing transmigrated into a book and became the pitiful and short-lived cannon fodder sister of the vicious female supporting character in the story.

“Mother, you kindly took in the cousin, yet she covets my father and wants to become his concubine. Soon, she will harm you to death~”

my-wife-is-a-general-who-killed-tens-of-:
Su Wen transmigrated and became the Prime Minister’s son, possessing both power and money.
In the capital, Su Wen was known to be a profligate young master who had no cares.
However, all of this was merely a façade. He was provided with a goldfinger which was a cultivation system that rewarded him for triggering intense emotions in others.
He put on the image of an arrogant playboy to incur the negative emotions of others to farm points for his cultivation.
Thus, he started on the path towards the pinnacle of life.
But when he turned 18, something happened.
A general’s daughter went to war on behalf of her father and managed to rout the enemy, killing 40,000 of them.
Such startling news became the talk of the town and everyone was apprehensive when they talked about this woman who killed without batting an eye.
Meanwhile, Su Wen who had been having fun sowing his wild seeds in the capital was suddenly granted a marriage by the emperor. He was to marry this woman, the Goddess of Death.
qt-against-my-will:
“We are well aware that the relationship between us is not healthy. Our love is far from perfect. It’s messed up. Just like us.”
– Bing Shi & Mr. Jelly
After a painful separation, Bing Shi gets a once in a lifetime opportunity to get back together with the ‘love of her life’ under one condition. To get one of her wishes granted, she will have to travel to different worlds and finish all the assigned missions from the System HeadQuarters.
In each world, she will encounter the best species of men — men that are many times more influential than the Mr. Jelly from her previous life. Will she be able to resist the alpha men that could make any human fall to their knees?
Bing Shi is not sure if she will be able to finish all the missions, but she will surely stay loyal to her boyfriend until the very end.
No matter what it takes, she will be stronger than the bad things that have happened to her.
She will be stronger than the sadness that threatens to consume her.
She will be stronger than the darkness that tries to pull her down.
And, because of that, she will be able to keep moving forward and find a way to make life work for her......
reincarnated-as-a-failed-hero-watch-me-d: Takahiro Nao, a 25-year-old burdened by crushing debt and driven solely by his love for his struggling family, meets a tragic end—until a mysterious Goddess of Benevolence offers him a second chance: reincarnated in another world, and his efforts there will provide for his family back on Earth. Awakening in the body of Naoki von Blackmore, a disgraced “Failed Hero,” Nao is thrust into a realm of sword and magic, monsters, and war, tasked with the impossible mission of defeating the Demon King. With newfound powers, a shadowy past, and the weight of two worlds on his shoulders, he must battle not only relentless enemies but fate itself. Blending emotional depth, thrilling action, moments of humor, and a spark of romance, this gripping isekai adventure asks: how far would you go—and what would you sacrifice—for the people you love?
